WOODWORK — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Preparation of Wood.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Preparation of Wood.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Preparation of Wood.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Preparation of Wood.
